title: Tiny Life
prompt:
Build a tiny life sim about keeping a creature well. One in-game hour lasts 60 ticks; the game starts on day 1 at 08:00 with hunger, energy and fun at 80 (clamped to 0-100) and 20 coins. Every hour hunger -3, fun -2, and energy -2 while awake or +8 while asleep. Actions: feed (5 coins, hunger +25), play (fun +20, energy -10), work (+10 coins, energy -15, fun -10; needs energy 15+), sleep (toggle; play and work refuse while asleep). At midnight day increases, score = days completed, and a seeded event either gives 5 coins or costs 5 fun. Any need reaching 0 ends the game. Keyboard: F feed, P play, W work, S sleep. Touch/mouse: four buttons on the canvas.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, day, hour (0-23), hunger, energy, fun, coins, asleep}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.feed(): returns false when refused
- Game.input.play(): returns false when refused
- Game.input.work(): returns false when refused
- Game.input.sleep(): toggle sleep
- Game.buttonCenter(name): canvas point of 'feed', 'play', 'work' or 'sleep'

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): hourly decay, each action, sleep, day rollover, neglect, seeded days, keyboard, click and tap.
